visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In the opening phase, a young woman with her dark hair styled in a messy top bun is seen in a bathroom setting. She wears a white waffle-knit robe and round-rimmed glasses, looking directly into the camera lens with a smile. She raises her right hand to gently adjust the bridge of her glasses, showcasing clear facial expressions and a relaxed posture against a background of white tiles and a dark wooden door. (2) As the video progresses, the subject moves her right hand swiftly towards the camera lens, effectively covering the entire frame. This physical movement creates a visual wipe transition. The lighting remains consistent as the hand blocks the view, signaling a change in the visual narrative while the background elements remain static behind the moving hand. (3) In the final phase, the woman reappears after the hand-wipe, now with her long black hair let down and neatly styled. She has changed her attire to a cream-colored, short-sleeved top and a black skirt. She stands in the same tiled environment, posing with increased confidence and looking steadily at the camera while shifting her torso slightly to display her transformed appearance.
